guideStoryTitle:
The title shown in the story list.
e.g. A Contract Marriage with the Arrogant Duke
guideStoryDesc:
The introduction shown below the story cover.
Write one or two sentences to hook readers.
guideStoryHashtag:
Enter hashtags starting with # separated by commas or spaces.
e.g. #romance #obsession #fantasy
guideStoreCover:
The cover image shown in the story list.

Recommended ratio: 2:3 (portrait, e.g. 400×600px)
→ Optimized for card-style vertical layout
→ Landscape images may be cropped top/bottom
guideCharImage:
Character profile image (max 5).
The first image is used as the default.
Tap  at the top-right of an image to remove it.

Recommended ratio: 1:1 or 3:4
→ Optimized for circular profile crop
→ Crop with face centered
guideCharEmotion:
Sets this character's initial emotion toward the user (you).
Drag or tap the circle to adjust.
Positive emotions are closer to +100, negative to -100.
guideCharPersonality: Describe this character's personality and speech style in detail.
guideCharExample: Write a short example situation showing the character's speech and personality.
guideCoreKeywords: Enter keywords (comma-separated) that trigger this Story Core to be sent to the AI.
guideCoreContent: The content sent to the AI when a keyword is detected.
guideWorldSetting:
Write only unchanging lore that stays constant across all chapters.
This is a fixed prompt the AI always references.
※ Info that changes per chapter goes in the Chapter Extra Info field.
guideAiGoal:
Write the AI's overall purpose or direction for this chapter.
e.g. Tries to build trust with the protagonist, but keeps distance fearing their past will be exposed.
guideCharGoal:
The goal this character pursues in this chapter.
Each character can have different goals, creating a more layered story.
e.g. Approaches the protagonist to steal a secret document.
guidePrevSummary:
Key events the AI must remember from the previous chapter.
Used by AI to understand story continuity.
Brief and focused on key events, relationship and emotion changes is best.
guideChapterInfo:
Changes or extra info the AI needs to know for this chapter.
※ This field resets when the chapter changes.
guideChapterTrigger:
The condition that triggers the next chapter.
Add multiple conditions — any one being met will trigger the transition.

Combine Cache Depletion with emotion or conversation count conditions for better memory retention and smoother progression.
guideIntro:
The first content shown when the chat begins.
Tap Narration / Character / User buttons to add as the appropriate speech bubble.
Inner thought: ##text## | Action: **text**
guideBackground:
Sets the background image for the game.
Add multiple conditions — any one OR condition met triggers a background switch.

Recommended ratio: 9:16 (fullscreen portrait, e.g. 1080×1920px)
→ Fits smartphone full-screen
→ 16:9 landscape may show letterboxing
